synthetic.interpretation: The Marina Alta ecosystem faces simultaneous crises across all anchor commodities. The chain average balance of 86.3% (Good zone) masks severe phase-level divergence: Phase 4 (Quality Certification) at 98.3% represents world-class institutional capacity, while Phase 6 (Crop Transition) at 75.0% and Phase 2 (Harvest) at 76.5% represent critical failure points. The structural diagnosis is clear: excellent downstream certification and market infrastructure cannot compensate for a broken agricultural production and investment system. The climate adaptation investment gap (Phase 6) is the single highest-priority intervention point.
